scope: Correspondence-judge transfer to camera-projected positions on existing test videos; not functional camera DNF validation
history: These twenty videos are disjoint from judge training/development but were already used for classical correspondence and learned-judge testing. They are not a new untouched benchmark. No calibration videos are used.
camera_inputs: Every original RGB frame in each named video, no subsampling or outcome-based sequence selection. Read only video arrays, not point or visibility annotation arrays. Use existing pinned DAGE and DA3 checkpoints, prior 252-pixel settings, and DA3 query-chunk 256. Save predicted camera poses and predicted calibration. One fresh process per attempt; retain all forty attempts and failures.
marker_protocol: Every existing first-visible query from the frozen RGB-only tracker; fit a single point from the first ten consecutive observations beginning at that query, using estimated cameras and calibration. Require all ten fitting observations. Project into query+15, query+30, query+60 without later refitting or later tracked positions. Retain beyond-video, missing fit, degenerate, nonpositive-depth, and off-image cases.
validation_only: Use reviewed TAP-Vid point positions and visibility only after candidate geometry is fixed to label projected positions: close at <=2 native Euclidean pixels, far at >=8, occluded separately, 2-8 margin unlabelled. Rendering and VLM inputs contain no reference labels. These labels validate correspondence judgments, not staticness or camera accuracy.
judge: Same frozen twenty-pass adapter, base arm, prompt, panel renderer, and greedy decoding used previously. No new training, checkpoint selection, or threshold tuning on this transfer study.
reporting: All planned tracks/queries/methods including unavailable and borderline outcomes; paired base/adapted accuracy only where independent correspondence labels exist, with coverage. No camera winner or DNF rate inferred from these correspondence labels. Correlated examples summarized at video level.
limitations: Predicted intrinsics, uncertain prefix fits, moving points, previously examined test videos, pretrained exposure unknown, and no independent camera-usability labels. Intended to test candidate-position transfer, not validate the complete proposed metric.
